sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1984
ORDINANCE II OF 1984
COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Cost and Management Accountants Act, 1966
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The following
Ordinance ,trade by the President is hereby published for general information
:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Cost and Management Accountants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
